description: Solo MCP endpoint discovery, tool list, and access checks

behaviors.description: POST /mcp answers discovery, lists the workflow tools, lists runs, lists status events, and refuses a bad header or a foreign origin.

prerequisites: Built target Web UI and E2E dependencies
proof_obligations: server/discover names archon, protocol 2026-07-28, and the tasks and events extensions
tools/list returns run_workflow, get_run, and list_runs
list_runs returns a runs array from the live server
A missing protocol header is HTTP 400 and JSON-RPC -32020
